summary: Franklin County, MA wooden lookout first operated in 1914 on Cran Pond Hill; a windstorm destroyed it in 1918 and it was never replaced; register lists inaccessible private land.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in a severe windstorm in summer 1918 and never replaced

access.note: Register says the tower site is on inaccessible private property

events.note: Register says the wooden tower first operated in 1914; staffing is not stated
Destroyed in a severe wind storm in summer 1918; never replaced

notes_for_editor: Only the register page could be read, so the history rests on one source. Facebook posts by the FFLA Massachusetts chapter could not be loaded (login wall). Their text appeared only in search snippets, which say the tower stood on Peter Hill and give a different staffing span (1914 to 1916, or 1914 to 1918). Not verified and not used in the story. Those snippets also mention remnants on the hill; also unverified and not used. The brief lists kind as unknown; the register says wooden tower, so kind could be set to tower. Staffing end and any surviving remains are not covered by sources read.
